name: CSO_DB_FORUM
description: This table contains the discussion forums records.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the category associated with this forum. This field allows null in order to have categoryless forums.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: DISCUSSION_BOARD_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the discussion board.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This is the End date for forum record.

columns.name: OVERRIDE
columns.description: Flag that determines if the security has been overriden from the discussion board. 1 - OVERRIDE, 0 - DEFAULT

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REFERENCE_KEY
columns.description: Locale independent name used to uniquely identify a discussion forum object.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This is the Start datetime for forum record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that created the record.
